scenario.summary: Guest opens the Departments menu and checks the eight top-level category links, expands Plumbing and checks its four subcategory links, opens the Plumbing PLP (subcategory tiles, heading, breadcrumb), checks the page-size options and the 'Showing N of 32 Results' text for sizes 8/12/16/64, opens the Faucets subcategory and walks the breadcrumb back to Plumbing and Home. Read-only.
steps: Open the webstore home as a guest (empty storageState) and open Departments.
Check the eight category links (CATEGORY_LINKS constant), expand Plumbing (spnPlumbing83RightIcon) and check its four subcategory links.
Click linkPlumbing; check URL /category/83 and the four subcategory tiles.
Check page-size options 8,12,16,32,64; set 8, 12, 16, 64 and check 'Showing N of 32 Results' each time.
Open Faucets (linkFaucetsCategory); check URL /category/85, heading 'Faucets', breadcrumb 'Home/Plumbing / Faucets'.
Click breadcrumb Plumbing (URL /category/83), then Home; check the navigation shows 'Departments'.
assertions: Each Departments link shows its category name; each Plumbing subcategory link and tile is visible.
Heading and breadcrumb show the category (Plumbing) and the subcategory path (Home/Plumbing / Faucets).
'Showing 8|12|16|32 of 32 Results' after each page-size change (32 = products in the category).
URLs /category/83 and /category/85 after navigation; navigation contains 'Departments'.
evidence: Title 'verify categories, paginations and breadcrumbs' and the ten step labels match the flow; guest storageState; no data file, no linked AIO cases.
Profile (atstage 2026-11-01): every value is NO_RULE (profiled false).
